sources.title: What are classification models? - IBM
sources.snippet: Classification models are a type of machine learning model that divides data points into predefined groups called classes. Classifiers are a type of predictive modeling that learns class characteristics from input data and learns to assign possible classes to new data according to those learned characteristics. 1 Classification algorithms are widely used in data science for forecasting ...

sources.title: Deep Learning Models for Classification: A Complete Guide - Metana
sources.snippet: The best deep learning model for binary classification will depend on the specific dataset and the desired accuracy. However, some of the most commonly used deep learning models for binary classification include logistic regression, support vector machines, and neural networks.
